criteria.description: Frontmatter schema accepts an omitted coverImage, HTTPS URLs, and site-root paths; it rejects blank values, HTTP URLs, and other relative paths.
criteria.notes: Verify with frontmatter schema tests; no network availability check is required.

criteria.description: An article configured with coverImage renders that image as the article detail page Hero background and preload image.
criteria.evidence: Temporary fixture static-build assertion verified custom Hero background and preload use coverImage
criteria.notes: Verify generated static HTML for an article configured with a valid coverImage.

criteria.description: An article without coverImage renders heroConfig.postDefaultBackground as both the article detail page Hero background and preload image.
criteria.evidence: Temporary fixture and existing article static-build assertions verified the configured and default Hero/preload paths
criteria.notes: Verify generated static HTML for an existing article without coverImage.

criteria.description: All existing articles without coverImage pass schema validation and the production static-site build without Frontmatter migration.
criteria.evidence: npm run build completed with 28 static pages; no existing article Frontmatter modified
criteria.notes: Verify with npm run build and confirm no existing article Frontmatter requires modification.

criteria.description: The Frontmatter standard documents coverImage as optional, shows a supported image-reference example, and retains legacy cover-field prohibitions.
criteria.evidence: Frontmatter standard assertions in frontmatter-schema.test.ts passed with the 20-test suite
